title: Prime Minister congratulates Gulveer Singh on winning Bronze in Men’s 5000m at Asian Games
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has congratulated Gulveer Singh on winning the Bronze medal in the Men’s 5000m event at the Asian Games.
The Prime Minister said that it has been a special Asian Games for Gulveer Singh and described his achievement as a remarkable hat-trick of podium finishes.
Shri Modi lauded his consistency, endurance and determination and extended his best wishes for many more successes in the future.
The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X;
“It’s truly been a special Asian Games for Gulveer Singh!
Congratulations to him on winning the Bronze in the Men’s 5000m. It’s a remarkable hat-trick of podium finishes. His consistency, endurance and determination are noteworthy. Best wishes to him for many more successes ahead: PM @narendramodi”
